The capacity plan failed validation because Phase 8 demand was recorded as 0.0 instead of the required reference value of 238.66.
The verifier returned a reward of 0.00 due to a call_failed status in test_output.py. Specifically, test_plan_math_and_policy failed with an AssertionError: 'Phase 8: demand 0.0 does not match reference 238.66'. While the plan correctly generated 49 rows for phases 8-56, the demand values in the output file did not align with the source data in ref_demands. Ensure the plan logic correctly maps reference demand values to each phase row starting from INITIAL_PHASE8_TOTAL.
